Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Hatsune Miku’s is back for the third stop on her Secret Lair tour, and this time she’s brought her friends! The digital diva is joined by the rest of the Character Vocal Series in an absolute party of a drop. This ensemble of electric superstars and fan-favorite cards is a can’t-miss collaboration!
Art by Naomi Baker, Clint Cearley, Jesper Ejsing, RAITA KAZAMA, Livia Prima
Contents:
• 1x Japanese Elspeth Tirel as “Miku, Divine Diva”
• 1x Japanese Jace, Unraveler of Secrets as “KAITO Mysterious Maestro”
• 1x Japanese Liliana of the Dark Realms as “Luka, the Traveling Sound”
• 1x Japanese Freyalise, Llanowar’s Fury as “Miku, Voice of Power”
• 1x Japanese The Royal Scions as “Len and Rin, Harmony Incarnate”
